scope: Independent code/contract review of lab_audit-authored kernel and communication components; root authoring/runner work is reviewed separately by other agents.
Kernel entry/exception/mapping/ELF/syscall/block/reboot mechanisms, full T48 module and project progression/metadata.
Full communication assessor cores and public APIs, HTTP/socket/malformed-input/MCU checks, selected transport/credit/timer tests and exact manifest scopes.

findings.finding: Freestanding memmove used relational pointer ordering across distinct objects.
findings.resolution: Both helpers now compare uintptr_t under the explicit flat x86-64 implementation profile.

findings.finding: Boot tag size rounding could overflow before bounds validation.
findings.resolution: Checked advancement rejects oversized/wrapped tag extents; archive name boundaries also gained negative cases.

findings.finding: Early kernel projects selected a cumulative full guest before later mechanisms existed.
findings.resolution: Project01 has an actual boot-only smoke;03–10 keep immediate hosted gates or manual traces and defer cumulative guest;11 and integrations require real guest execution.

findings.finding: Kernel integration documentation offered only assessor paths in the learner export.
findings.resolution: Primary commands now consume completed learner src/include/adapters; assessor selection is explicitly author-only.

findings.finding: RTT weighted arithmetic overflowed for admitted uint32 samples.
findings.resolution: uint64 weighted intermediates and a repeated UINT32_MAX sample regression preserve estimator arithmetic.

findings.finding: An unrelated FIN could restart TIME-WAIT.
findings.resolution: Only the bounded duplicate FIN sequence refreshes the timer; unrelated-sequence rejection is checked.

findings.finding: Completed and duplicate-final EDU7 acknowledgments advertised credit while the receiver slot was occupied.
findings.resolution: Both report current slot credit; tests distinguish occupied and released receipts, and caller admission of new messages is explicit.

findings.finding: The initial HTTP header test required later body framing, and a transport milestone selected a later bridge test.
findings.resolution: Headers now use bodyless origin/absolute GET every-split controls; binary Content-Length moved to framing; complete bridge is deferred.

execution_authority: Final current-source release execution is required separately by tools/accept_v2.py using reviews/v2/lab_matrix.json; historical author runs are not promoted to new source identities.
limits: Static independent review and finite tests do not prove all kernel or protocol states.
Ethernet-to-HTTP and EDU7 components retain the full-project obligations explicitly listed in family manifests, including active ARP, full grant scheduling, vendor drivers and physical closure.
No physical interface, electrical timing, real disk power-cut, production TCP/IP/HTTP conformance, learner transfer or time-calibration claim.
